positioning.statement: For content and comms teams who have automated execution but lost strategic oversight, SkillFoundry is a strategic firewall (strategy as code) that routes every asset through three opinionated gates before it ships. Unlike SaaS visibility dashboards you log into and rent per seat, SkillFoundry runs inside your own agent workflow, spans relevance, enterprise value, and algorithmic signal in a single pass, and can be owned outright with a perpetual license.
alternatives: GEO / AEO visibility dashboards (Profound, Otterly, Peec, Scrunch, Athena)
AI content-optimization / SEO writing tools (Surfer SEO, Clearscope, MarketMuse, Writer)
PR measurement platforms owning the C-suite report (Muck Rack, Cision)
Do nothing: prompt ChatGPT / Claude directly, or hire a GEO agency
attributes: Runs inside the team's own agent workflow (MCP-native, local), not one more SaaS dashboard to log into
One firewall spanning three strategic gates (JTBD relevance, enterprise value, algorithmic signal) instead of three separate point tools
Perpetual-license ownership option, not per-seat rent
Gates content before it ships and returns a structured audit you can defend to the C-suite
Clean-room original gate logic, self-contained, no third-party lock-in
positioning.value: Restores strategic oversight over automated content before it publishes, in the workflow the team already uses, with a defensible C-suite audit, for the price of lunch rather than a per-seat SaaS contract.
positioning.bestFit: Content and comms teams (and boutique agencies) that have automated execution but lost strategic oversight, are comfortable in MCP-compatible clients, and would rather own their tooling than rent a dashboard.

recommendations.title: Own the "runs in your stack, not another dashboard" wedge
recommendations.body: Nearly every direct rival is a SaaS dashboard you log into and rent by the seat. SkillFoundry is the only strategic tool that runs inside the agent workflow the team already uses, via the open Model Context Protocol, and can be owned with a one-time license. Lead every conversation with in-workflow + ownership as the anti-SaaS play. MCP adoption is compounding fast (SDK downloads hit ~97M/month by March 2026), so this wedge widens over time.

recommendations.title: Sell the firewall, not the tracker
recommendations.body: GEO dashboards measure visibility after content ships; Surfer scores drafts for classic search. SkillFoundry gates every asset before it ships and spans three strategic layers that rivals split across three product categories. Bundle the C-suite Performance Delta Log (Gate 2) that pure GEO trackers simply do not produce.

recommendations.title: Attack on ownership at the low end and defensibility at the high end
recommendations.body: Against Profound's $399-$5,000/mo dashboards and $1,500-$50,000/mo GEO agencies, offer a $29 perpetual license (own vs rent) at entry. Against DIY prompting, offer a repeatable, versioned, auditable methodology instead of prompt drift living in a chat history. Concede enterprise compliance (SOC 2) as a roadmap item, not a fight to pick today.

positioningMap.yTop: Strategic firewall (relevance to value to signal)

whitespace.gap: No incumbent occupies the runs-in-your-stack + strategic-firewall quadrant. GEO tools track visibility after the fact; SEO tools score drafts for classic search; PR tools report coverage retrospectively; agencies rent you a methodology. Nobody gates content before it ships, across relevance + enterprise value + algorithmic signal, inside the team's own workflow, as software you can own.

basics: Multi-engine GEO/AEO visibility tracking (Profound and Otterly have made this table stakes)
Real-time content scoring (Surfer normalized this for SEO)
performance: Breadth of engines covered and prompt volume
Citation-share accuracy and freshness of tracking
delighters: MCP-native, in-workflow execution instead of a separate dashboard
Perpetual-license ownership instead of per-seat rent
One-pass, three-gate audit ending in a defensible C-suite Performance Delta Log
kano.note: Kano's warning applies: today's delighters become tomorrow's basics. As MCP adoption compounds, in-workflow delivery and ownership will become expected. SkillFoundry's window to own them as differentiators is now.

actionPlan.action: Lead demos with the pre-publish firewall and the C-suite Performance Delta Log, not with tracking. Frame their dashboards as the scoreboard and SkillFoundry as the thing that changes the score before content ships.
actionPlan.trap: "Great that you can see your AI visibility, but what actually changes the content before it ships? Is your team acting on a dashboard, or gating every asset inside the workflow they already use?"

actionPlan.target: vs Surfer SEO / Clearscope (SEO content tools)
actionPlan.action: Position Gate 3 (AEO/GEO structuring plus human-signal density) as the successor to keyword-density SEO, and remind buyers their price has climbed 2-3x while the search surface moved to answer engines.
actionPlan.trap: "Are you optimizing for ten blue links or for the answer engines that now cite sources? And does your content score survive being pasted into a C-suite deck?"

actionPlan.action: Sell the perpetual license as an owned, versioned, repeatable methodology. Contrast it with prompt drift in a chat history (DIY) and $1,500-$50,000/mo rented retainers (agency).
actionPlan.trap: "Can you reproduce last quarter's strategic review, or does it live in someone's chat history? Do you own the methodology, or rent it every month?"
